summary: Agent guidance and persona updates for Information Audits and Goals page (Epic #218 / Feature #225)

entries.migration_impact: Agents (via Copilot plugin, gh plate, MCP) now have explicit guidance for performing Information Audits (#221), using the Goals page convention (#224), generating/refining Questions per the model (#220), and integrating with Curiosity flows. Personas updated in plate.agent.md. Guidance exercised in Epic development. Future agent runs will produce better audits/Questions.
entries.agent_notes: See INFORMATION_AUDIT_GUIDANCE section (in agent_guidance) and the new section in plate.agent.md. Invoke plate_perform_information_audit (dry_run first), read Goals page, use catalog (#222), follow 10 rules (#223), feed to Curiosity. Use plate_informational_goals for defaults.
